{{Otheruses|Defense Force}}
The '''Kuat Defense Force''' was the [[Defense Force]] organized to defend the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. Like most military organizations at the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it promoted the use of [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and short-range [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
